g.text: Analytic / two-gate cost ratio (log color scale)

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 15px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start

g.text: Whole content-model execution: the finite-grid adapter is more costly

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #4c535d

g.text: 16 protocol strata · 3 seeds per cell · ratios above 1 favor the ordinary two-gate adapter

text.style: font-size: 8.9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #4c535d

g.text: Cell = arithmetic mean of analytic measurements / arithmetic mean of two-gate measurements. Latency averages per-seed validation p50s.

text.style: font-size: 8.9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #4c535d

g.text: CPU includes the entire fresh adapter worker. Common donor training is separate; adding the same donor cost preserves the direction.

text.style: font-size: 8.9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #4c535d

g.text: 20 CPU s is a training-loop budget. Timing covers prepared-feature execution on CPU; raw media decoding and energy were not measured.

text.style: font-size: 8.9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #4c535d

g.text: * AV quality is insufficient: emotion donors selected step 0; analytic binding accuracy is 50%. These are not quality-matched AV savings.
